items.q: “the sheets or tiles laid to keep water out” is the definition of
o: purlin
ridge board
flat roof
roof covering
items.s: roof covering is the sheets or tiles laid to keep water out.

items.q: “the measurement of work by volume” is the definition of
o: cubic measure
billing
enumerated item
deduction
items.s: cubic measure is the measurement of work by volume.

items.q: The correct meaning of cubic measure is
o: the priced list of the measured work
the measurement of work by area
the subtraction of an opening or void from a measured quantity
the measurement of work by volume
items.s: cubic measure: the measurement of work by volume. The other options describe superficial measure, bill of quantities, deduction.

items.q: In this course, masonry refers to
o: a bond of alternate stretchers and headers in each course
construction using units such as bricks or blocks bedded in mortar
the horizontal layer of mortar on which a unit is laid
the member carrying the wall over an opening
items.s: masonry: construction using units such as bricks or blocks bedded in mortar. The other options describe flemish bond, bed joint, lintel.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines strut?
o: the treatment of wood against rot and insects
a member that resists compression along its length
a sheet material made of wood chips bonded with resin
a timber that carries the ends of a shortened joist around an opening
items.s: strut: a member that resists compression along its length. The other options describe trimmer, timber preservation, particle board.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains plywood.
o: the board fixed along a wall to carry the ends of floor joists
a timber that carries the ends of a shortened joist around an opening
the short blocks fixed between studs to stiffen a partition
a sheet of veneers glued together with grains at right angles
items.s: plywood: a sheet of veneers glued together with grains at right angles. The other options describe ribbon board, trimmer, nogging.

items.q: stretcher bond may be defined as
o: a half unit used to finish a course at the end of a wall
the vertical mortar joint between two units
the corner unit of a wall
a bond in which all units are laid lengthwise in the wall
items.s: stretcher bond: a bond in which all units are laid lengthwise in the wall. The other options describe perpend joint, quoin, queen closer.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines unit rate?
o: work counted by number rather than measured by size
the working up of measured dimensions into quantities in a bill
the price of one unit of a measured item
the measurement of work by volume
items.s: unit rate: the price of one unit of a measured item. The other options describe billing, cubic measure, enumerated item.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains seasoning.
o: the short blocks fixed between studs to stiffen a partition
a horizontal timber that carries a floor or ceiling
timber from broad leaved trees, generally dense and strong
the drying of timber to reduce its moisture content
items.s: seasoning: the drying of timber to reduce its moisture content. The other options describe hardwood, nogging, joist.

items.q: In this course, builder line refers to
o: the arrangement of labour, plant and materials on a construction site
the taut line used to keep work straight and level
the drawing showing where stores, plant and huts are placed
the temporary working platform alongside a building
items.s: builder line: the taut line used to keep work straight and level. The other options describe site layout plan, site organisation, scaffold.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains render.
o: the coat of mortar applied to give a smooth wall or ceiling surface
the plaster coat applied to an external wall
the application of a protective and decorative coating
the accessible chamber on a drain for rodding and inspection
items.s: render: the plaster coat applied to an external wall. The other options describe plaster, inspection chamber, painting.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains supervision.
o: the taut line used to keep work straight and level
the oversight of the workforce to ensure work follows the drawings
the stage at which the works are fit for use and handed over
the marking of the building position and levels on the ground
items.s: supervision: the oversight of the workforce to ensure work follows the drawings. The other options describe builder line, practical completion, setting out.

items.q: The correct meaning of cube test is
o: the mixture of cement, fine aggregate, coarse aggregate and water that sets hard
the ease with which fresh concrete can be placed and compacted
the driving out of air from fresh concrete by vibration or tamping
the crushing test on a cube of hardened concrete to find its strength
items.s: cube test: the crushing test on a cube of hardened concrete to find its strength. The other options describe workability, compaction, concrete.

items.q: In this course, eaves refers to
o: a roof formed of sloping planes meeting at a ridge
a roof with only a slight fall for drainage
the lower overhanging edge of a roof
the timber laid on the wall to receive the feet of the rafters
items.s: eaves: the lower overhanging edge of a roof. The other options describe wall plate, pitched roof, flat roof.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines site layout plan?
o: the marking of the building position and levels on the ground
the drawing showing where stores, plant and huts are placed
the oversight of the workforce to ensure work follows the drawings
the written description of how a job will be carried out safely
items.s: site layout plan: the drawing showing where stores, plant and huts are placed. The other options describe method statement, supervision, setting out.
